title: Vendor Archive - Business Funnel
description: Business-facing vendor API metrics from ClickHouse: volume, success rate, user/loan impact, lifecycle funnel, and vendor reliability.

list.name: vendor
list.label: Vendor
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT vendor_id FROM vendor_archive.vendor_api_events ORDER BY vendor_id

list.name: service
list.label: Service
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT service FROM vendor_archive.vendor_api_events ORDER BY service

list.name: stage
list.label: Lifecycle Stage
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT toString(loan_lifecycle_stage) FROM vendor_archive.vendor_api_events ORDER BY toString(loan_lifecycle_stage)

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() AS calls FROM vendor_archive.vendor_api_events WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND vendor_id LIKE '$vendor' AND service LIKE '$service' AND toString(loan_lifecycle_stage) LIKE '$stage'

SELECT if(count() = 0, 0, round(countIf(status = 'SUCCESS') * 100.0 / count(), 2)) AS success_rate FROM vendor_archive.vendor_api_events WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND vendor_id LIKE '$vendor' AND service LIKE '$service' AND toString(loan_lifecycle_stage) LIKE '$stage'

SELECT uniqExact(user_id) AS users FROM vendor_archive.vendor_api_events WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND user_id != '' AND status != 'SUCCESS' AND vendor_id LIKE '$vendor' AND service LIKE '$service' AND toString(loan_lifecycle_stage) LIKE '$stage'

SELECT uniqExact(loan_application_number) AS loan_apps FROM vendor_archive.vendor_api_events WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND loan_application_number IS NOT NULL AND status != 'SUCCESS' AND vendor_id LIKE '$vendor' AND service LIKE '$service' AND toString(loan_lifecycle_stage) LIKE '$stage'

SELECT countIf(status IN ('TIMEOUT', 'NETWORK_ERROR')) AS transport_errors FROM vendor_archive.vendor_api_events WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND vendor_id LIKE '$vendor' AND service LIKE '$service' AND toString(loan_lifecycle_stage) LIKE '$stage'

SELECT quantile(0.95)(latency_ms) AS p95_ms FROM vendor_archive.vendor_api_events WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND vendor_id LIKE '$vendor' AND service LIKE '$service' AND toString(loan_lifecycle_stage) LIKE '$stage'

SELECT toStartOfMinute(created_at) AS time, vendor_id, count() AS calls FROM vendor_archive.vendor_api_events WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND vendor_id LIKE '$vendor' AND service LIKE '$service' AND toString(loan_lifecycle_stage) LIKE '$stage' GROUP BY time, vendor_id ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfMinute(created_at) AS time, vendor_id, if(count() = 0, 0, countIf(status = 'SUCCESS') * 100.0 / count()) AS success_rate FROM vendor_archive.vendor_api_events WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND vendor_id LIKE '$vendor' AND service LIKE '$service' AND toString(loan_lifecycle_stage) LIKE '$stage' GROUP BY time, vendor_id ORDER BY time

SELECT toString(loan_lifecycle_stage) AS stage, count() AS calls, uniqExact(user_id) AS users, uniqExact(loan_application_number) AS loan_apps, countIf(status = 'SUCCESS') AS successes, countIf(status != 'SUCCESS') AS failures, round(countIf(status = 'SUCCESS') * 100.0 / count(), 2) AS success_rate, round(quantile(0.95)(latency_ms), 0) AS p95_ms FROM vendor_archive.vendor_api_events WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND vendor_id LIKE '$vendor' AND service LIKE '$service' AND toString(loan_lifecycle_stage) LIKE '$stage' GROUP BY stage ORDER BY calls DESC

SELECT vendor_id, count() AS calls, countIf(status = 'SUCCESS') AS successes, countIf(status != 'SUCCESS') AS failures, round(countIf(status = 'SUCCESS') * 100.0 / count(), 2) AS success_rate, round(quantile(0.95)(latency_ms), 0) AS p95_ms, round(avg(latency_ms), 0) AS avg_ms FROM vendor_archive.vendor_api_events WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND vendor_id LIKE '$vendor' AND service LIKE '$service' AND toString(loan_lifecycle_stage) LIKE '$stage' GROUP BY vendor_id ORDER BY failures DESC, p95_ms DESC

SELECT vendor_id, endpoint, status, count() AS failures, uniqExact(user_id) AS impacted_users, round(avg(latency_ms), 0) AS avg_ms FROM vendor_archive.vendor_api_events WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND status != 'SUCCESS' AND vendor_id LIKE '$vendor' AND service LIKE '$service' AND toString(loan_lifecycle_stage) LIKE '$stage' GROUP BY vendor_id, endpoint, status ORDER BY failures DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT created_at, service, vendor_id, endpoint, toString(loan_lifecycle_stage) AS stage, loan_application_number, user_id, status, http_status, latency_ms, error_code, error_message, request_id FROM vendor_archive.vendor_api_events WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND status != 'SUCCESS' AND vendor_id LIKE '$vendor' AND service LIKE '$service' AND toString(loan_lifecycle_stage) LIKE '$stage' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100
